thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high 5xx error rate on eu-prod inference cluster (model-worker-3). alert_id=ALRT-9987, severity=page. 95th latency spiked to 1.2s, error-rate=3.4%
Lena (oncall): I got paged but i'm currently on holiday travel, battery low. I'm primary until 02:00 UTC but realistically can only handle triage until 00:30. pinging backup.
Ajay (backup): On it. I'm awake, can take primary now if needed. What's the immediate customer impact?
incident-bot: Recent trace: service=model-proxy -> backend=model-worker-3 -> 503 (upstream timeout). Affected routes: /v1/generate (eu region). Top caller: partner-api-34.
Samir: Thanks Ajay. Quick check: Priya, any running deploys to eu in the last hour?
Priya: No deploys from product in the last 2 hours. Nothing scheduled for the holiday window.
Ajay (backup): Ok i'll take the bridge. I'll open a quick huddle and start runbook steps. Lena, can you transfer primary in PagerDuty?
Lena (oncall): Done — marked 'handoff' and added Ajay as primary in PD. Also added note: "travelling, reachable by thread only".
Ajay (backup): Opening bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/3591234567 (created).
Joel (SRE manager): Thanks Ajay — if the error persists after runbook step 3, escalate to me and we'll promote a dedicated shard to handle partner traffic.
Ajay (backup): Running quick health checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference eu-worker-3 -o wide`
Ajay (backup): Pod eu-worker-3 shows RestartCount=7, OOMKilled=false, CPU spike. Kernel logs show repeated `nv_peer_mem` warnings.
Samir: Looks like a GPU driver hiccup or CUDA / nv_peer_mem regression. Is this limited to that node or the whole pool?
Priya: Metrics: node eu-node-7 shows GPU memory pressure and evictions. Other nodes stable.
Ajay (backup): Running runbook step 1 (drain and move traffic): `redwood route --from eu-node-7 --to eu-node-fallback --weight 100% --reason "draining bad node"`
ops-bot: Route change applied: traffic for /v1/generate (eu) moved to eu-node-fallback. Old node still marked Unhealthy.
Ajay (backup): After reroute, 95th latency down to 320ms, error-rate to 0.6%. Partner calls still see some 503s during the cutover window (couple of requests).
Lena (oncall): Good mitigation. Ajay, can you also kick the automated node restart and file for infra to look at drivers?
Ajay (backup): Triggered `redwood infra restart-node eu-node-7 --type soft`. Also filed ticket INFRA-4521 with logs and kernel dump.
Joel (SRE manager): Nice. Quick customer impact note: partner-api-34 will have seen intermittent 5xx for ~8 minutes with <1% of their requests failing. If Support needs to communicate, use wording: "brief intermittent errors in EU region, mitigated, no data loss, customers may have experienced failed requests between 23:17-23:25 UTC."
Priya: Confirming: no data persisted on failed requests; all retries succeeded after fallback.
Samir: Action items: 1) Ajay remains primary for the next hour and monitors. 2) Infra to investigate node drivers (INFRA-4521). 3) Add a health-probe change to prevent routing to node with repeated nv_peer_mem warnings.
Ajay (backup): I'll keep watch and post updates every 10m. Also enabling a temporary route-level retry policy for partner-api-34: `redwood routing update partner-api-34 --retries 2 --backoff 200ms`
incident-bot: Audit note: routing change and node restart executed by Ajay at 3591234680.
Lena (oncall): Thanks all — I'm reachable if needed but handing shift to Ajay. Enjoy the rest of the holiday. :beach_with_umbrella:
Ajay (backup): Handoff acknowledged. I'll tag Joël if we need escalation.
Joel (SRE manager): If node shows driver flakiness on restart, we'll schedule immediate cold migration and cordon the node. I'll ping infra on-call.
Priya: Small follow-up: we should add an evaluation to Optimize to suggest lower batch sizes for that model on GPU memory pressure patterns. Filing OPT-1209.
Samir: Noted.
Ajay (backup): Monitoring shows stable for now. 95th latency 310ms, error-rate 0.2% for last 10m. I'll close the bridge when metrics are green for 30m.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: bridge check-in in 10m.
Ajay (backup): Closing note before I step out: primary changed in PD to Ajay, secondary Samir. If pager fires again, page Joël after 2 pages.
incident-bot: Incident closed (ALRT-9987) at 3591234890 — reroute + node restart mitigated the issue.
Lena (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll add a post-incident note to the oncall doc with the timeline.
Joel (SRE manager): Great runbook execution. We'll review driver root cause and follow up in postmortem.
Priya: leaving a quick comment for support comms: "Monitoring alert — resolved. If partners ask, share incident window and mitigation steps."
Ajay (backup): Bridge closed. Signing off as primary.
